project.title: Characterization of the bacterial composition of drinking water supply systems in northern communities
project.description: The study aimed to assess the microbiological quality of water from source to tap in northern communities across Nunavut, Nunavik, and the Northwest Territories. We examined the bacterial composition of drinking water and its relationship with dissolved organic matter to identify the environmental drivers underlying changes in microbiological quality.
project.center_name: Institut national de la recherche scientifique
